title: LanguageProfile
description: Data-driven, parameterized language profile specification for text normalization, chapter boundary detection, typography, naming conventions, and inline annotations across multilingual publications without code-level language branching.

id.description: BCP-47 language tag identifier (e.g. 'zh-Hans', 'en', 'ja') or 'generic' for the fallback profile.

name.description: Human-readable display name for this language profile.

description.description: Detailed explanation of this profile's configuration and target language.

version.description: Semantic version string of the language profile (e.g. '1.0.0'). Bumps whenever extraction, segmentation, or detection behavior changes.

script_family.description: Script or writing system family classification (e.g. 'han', 'latin', 'cjk_mixed', 'kana', 'generic').

chapter_rules.description: Ordered list of chapter boundary detection rules.

id.description: Unique identifier for the chapter detection rule pattern.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern used to detect chapter boundaries.

capture_group.description: Zero-based regex capture group index containing the chapter heading or title.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this rule matches.

priority.description: Evaluation priority order when multiple patterns match.

quote_pairs.description: List of paired opening and closing quotation mark delimiters.

items.description: A pair consisting of exactly one opening delimiter and one closing delimiter.

honorifics.description: Prefixes, suffixes, or titles associated with character names.

alias_markers.description: Keywords or patterns indicating alias, nickname, or pseudonym relations.

ruby_policy.description: Policy for handling inline phonetic annotations (ruby text) in source documents.

parentheses.description: Opening and closing parentheses delimiters when strategy is 'parenthesize'.

order.description: Typical naming order (e.g. 'family_first' in Chinese/Japanese or 'given_first' in English).
